identity_before.scope: local in-process full identity POST, enforced CSRF; no injected network latency

identity_after.scope: local in-process full identity POST, enforced CSRF; no injected network latency

scope: Local isolated PostgreSQL 17.6; no cross-region latency injection, no Render deployment or requests. Performance comparisons ran serially. One run per candidate, not significance proof.
notes: Concurrent mode is 126 distinct flows at concurrency 42, not a single batch of 42. Each build stores 139 submissions including warmup and single-user flows.
Journey times sum sequential HTTP requests including followed redirects, not human think time or browser page load.
Full identity POST query count is from enforced-CSRF in-process probe, not pooled phase metrics including redirect responses.
Duplicate regression uses retries; raw 409/503 remain in the attached report.
Earlier intermediate after-only benchmarks were exploratory and excluded from final comparison.
No concurrent-staging health recovery or 502 resolution has been demonstrated.
